newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to take steps on any sharp forex moves - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan to take steps on any sharp forex moves - MOF.

text.p: Japan will take appropriate measures to tackle any excessive moves in foreign exchange markets, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Wednesday.

Asked whether the cooperation agreed by the Group of Seven (G7) nations on currencies at their weekend meeting meant a coordinated intervention, Mitsuzuka declined to comment on the issue of intervention.
But he added: "We will continue to watch movements in the forex markets and take appropriate measures to tackle any excessive moves."
He also said the yen's weakening against the dollar in Asian trade on Wednesday was a result of the dollar's rise against the mark.
"It has been mostly the buying back of dollars for marks, and the dollar/yen rate has risen in tandem," Mitsuzuka said.
